fields.text: Upload a product still; MiniMax H3 Max Multi Angle (`minimax/h3-max/multi-angle/image-to-video`) animates a precise camera move. Pins: 480p, 5s, camera_motion=orbit-right in modelOpts (catalog default; also orbit-left / push-in / pull-back / rise). Catalog minimum $0.25; duration and resolution determine pricing. First-click story is a matte-charcoal Volt pocket night-ride radio with one electric-cyan lightning-bolt chevron on dark slate / hard cyan rim — this repo has no committed still, so upload that product photo or any catalog plate. Camera moves; the product stays. Not Animate a product still (Muse + MiniMax H3 Spicy locked-camera rain), not Product motion concept (GLM + Omni Flash 1.1 text-to-video studio plinth), and not InfiniteTalk / talking-avatar lipsync. Inspect one continuous orbit; a seamless loop is not promised.

fields.prompt: Only the camera moves: orbit around the subject, preserving the scene.
